question: Ordered boosting moved 2023 by +232, the largest single-season movement measured here, and was blocked only by 2022 at -59.34. The 2022 fold trains on three seasons and the deployed model on six. Ordered boosting fits trees on prefixes of random permutations, so unlike plain boosting it has a mechanism that makes sample size matter.
control: V121 measured plain boosting under this identical design and found it flat at 757/748/765/745, so any ordered slope is attributable to the method.
